from tools import search_flights, filter_flights, save_to_cache, get_results_from_cache

# Retrieve the cached flight search results that match the initial criteria (St. Louis to Memphis, dates, 1 layover max, 60 min max layover)
flights = get_results_from_cache(key="flights")

# Apply the time-based filters for departure and arrival times as specified by the user
filtered_flights = filter_flights(
    prior_results=flights,
    departure_time=["23:31:00", "23:31:00"],
    arrival_time=["00:00:00", "14:26:00"],
    airline=["AE"],
    flight_class=["economy"]
)

# Save the filtered results to the cache for future reference
save_to_cache(key="filtered_flights", value=filtered_flights)

# Output the query summary to the user
print(filtered_flights.query_summary)
